name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Income support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families.
benefits: Income support; confirm current amount and conditions on the official portal.
eligibilityText: For eligible landholding farmer families, subject to scheme exclusions. Confirm current criteria on the official portal.
howToApply: Check current registration instructions on the official portal.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Government-funded health assurance scheme for eligible families.
benefits: Health coverage subject to current scheme limits and conditions.
howToApply: Check eligibility and enrollment guidance on the National Health Authority portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Housing programme for eligible urban households.
benefits: Housing assistance under applicable programme components and guidelines.
howToApply: Check the current PMAY-U application process and component rules on the official portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Housing assistance programme for eligible rural households.
benefits: Housing assistance according to current programme guidelines.
howToApply: Check beneficiary and application information through the Ministry of Rural Development.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Small savings scheme for a girl child's future, available through authorized channels.
benefits: Long-term savings account; current interest and account rules are published by the government.
howToApply: Confirm account-opening rules and authorized channels with the National Savings Institute.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services
description: Credit support initiative for eligible micro and small business activities.
benefits: Business credit through participating lenders; loan terms depend on the lender and current rules.
howToApply: Contact a participating lender and confirm current scheme details with the Department of Financial Services.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit programme supporting eligible street vendors.
benefits: Working-capital credit and related support under current scheme guidelines.
eligibilityText: For eligible street vendors. Check current vendor identification and application rules on the official portal.
howToApply: Check vendor eligibility and application guidance on the official portal.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services
description: Contributory pension scheme with enrollment rules set by the Government of India.
benefits: Pension benefits depend on the selected contribution option and current scheme rules.
eligibilityText: The general entry age is 18 to 40 years. Confirm current eligibility and exclusions before applying.
howToApply: Ask a participating bank or post office about enrollment and current eligibility.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
ministry: Ministry of Education and participating Central Ministries
description: Government portal for discovering and applying to participating scholarship schemes.
benefits: Scholarship availability and benefits vary by the selected scheme.
howToApply: Review the individual scholarship's rules and application dates on the portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: LPG connection programme for eligible adult women from qualifying households.
benefits: LPG connection assistance subject to current scheme rules and eligibility.
eligibilityText: The applicant is generally an adult woman. Check current household and application criteria on the official portal.
howToApply: Contact an LPG distributor or use the official portal to confirm the current application process.

name: PM Vishwakarma
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Support programme for traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools.
benefits: May include skill training, credit, technology and market support under scheme guidelines.
eligibilityText: For eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople in notified trades. Applicants are generally required to be at least 18 years old; verify current rules.
howToApply: Check eligible trades and registration instructions on the official portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Crop insurance scheme for farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
benefits: Insurance protection subject to notified crops, areas and current scheme terms.
eligibilityText: For farmers with an insurable interest in notified crops in notified areas. Confirm current enrollment rules locally.
howToApply: Check notified crops and enrollment dates through the official portal or participating institution.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Rural employment guarantee programme for eligible rural households.
benefits: Wage employment under the Act for eligible rural households.
eligibilityText: Rural household members aged 18 years or older may apply for unskilled manual work under the Act.
howToApply: Contact the Gram Panchayat or check the official programme portal for current instructions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services
description: Financial inclusion programme supporting access to basic banking services.
benefits: Access to eligible basic banking services and linked benefits under current rules.
howToApply: Contact a participating bank or review account-opening information on the official portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services
description: Government life insurance scheme available through participating institutions.
benefits: Life insurance cover subject to current policy terms and enrollment conditions.
eligibilityText: The general entry age is 18 to 50 years. Confirm current account and enrollment requirements.
howToApply: Check enrollment availability and policy terms with a participating bank or post office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services
description: Government accident insurance scheme available through participating institutions.
benefits: Accident insurance cover subject to current policy terms and enrollment conditions.
eligibilityText: The general entry age is 18 to 70 years. Confirm current account and enrollment requirements.
howToApply: Check enrollment availability and policy terms with a participating bank or post office.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Credit-linked programme for setting up eligible new micro-enterprises.
benefits: Project support under current PMEGP guidelines; assistance depends on eligibility and project details.
eligibilityText: Individual applicants are generally required to be at least 18 years old. Verify current conditions and exclusions.
howToApply: Check current application guidance through the Ministry of MSME and its official PMEGP portal.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Rural livelihoods mission supporting community institutions and eligible rural households.
benefits: Livelihood and community-institution support under current mission guidelines.
howToApply: Contact the State Rural Livelihoods Mission or check Ministry of Rural Development information.

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Social assistance programme covering eligible older persons, widows and persons with disabilities.
benefits: Assistance under applicable pension components and current guidelines.
howToApply: Check the relevant component's criteria and application process with the State or local authority.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Skill development programme supporting eligible candidates through approved training.
benefits: Training and assessment under current programme rules and available courses.
howToApply: Review current courses and enrollment guidance through the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
